subject: POC: Trial planning & timeline - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Trial planning & timeline - Acme Corp

Hi Alice / Bob -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your trial kicked off on a predictable schedule. Please confirm the success criteria below and your availability for the kickoff week I propose.

Recap (from discovery):
- Goal: Validate that Redwood reduces per-token inference cost by ~35% for your LLM-powered search reranking pipeline while keeping median tail latency < 250ms for user-facing flows.
- Primary users: Search engineers (Bob) + analytics team for offline evals (Alice).
- Data: We'll need a representative sample of ~50k queries + topK results; if any of that is sensitive we can use a synthetic subset or run in your VPC.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
1) Kickoff + infra prep (week 0) - access, test data, VPN/K8s credentials (if using Private).
2) Integration & baseline collection (week 1) - connect to a dev endpoint, run baseline metrics.
3) Optimization & tuning (week 2) - batching, KV cache, quantization profile suggestions.
4) Final readout & handoff (week 3) - performance/cost summary, runbook, next steps.

Draft success criteria (please confirm/edit):
- 35% reduction in per-token inference cost (measured over representative traffic sampling).
- Median P95 latency below 250ms on your dev load.
- No functional regressions on the top-10 reranking result set (accuracy tolerance: <=1.5% delta on metrics you define).

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (project lead) + Ethan (technical lead) - provide endpoints, run controlled experiments, produce the readout deck.
- Acme: Alice (product), Bob (engineering) - provide data access, define accuracy thresholds, validate results.

Proposed timeline / milestones (dates tentative):
- Proposed kickoff: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 - 30-60m alignment meeting
- Weekly check-ins: every Tue 10:00am PT (6 Jul, 13 Jul, 20 Jul, 27 Jul)
- Final readout: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 - 60m review (deck + metrics)

Attachments: POC_SOW_Acme_v1.pdf (scope & T&Cs), poc-timeline.xlsx (detailed milestones) - attached for your review.

Open questions / asks for Acme:
- Confirm the success criteria above or propose edits.
- Confirm whether we should use sample data in Redwood hosted environment or request access to a VPC deployment.
- Confirm procurement next steps / PO process (cc procurement if helpful).

If that looks good I'll schedule the kickoff for Tue 6 Jul 10:00am PT and send calendar invites.

Thanks -

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

Subject: Re: POC: Trial planning & timeline - Acme Corp

Thanks Marissa - helpful recap. A few edits/notes from our side:

- Success criteria: +1 on cost reduction target; can we express accuracy tolerance as "<=1% absolute change on our NDCG@10 benchmark" instead of the percent delta you suggested? That maps better to our scoring.
- Latency: P95 < 250ms is fine, but can we also call out 95th percentile tail for p99 (we'd like to keep p99 < 600ms for user-facing tests).
- Data: we'll provide a 50k sample set. For the POC initial run please use a redacted dataset in your hosted environment; if we move to a private deployment later we'll handle VPC steps.

Procurement note (cc'd): Our procurement team will need the SOW and a standard MSA redline. Procurement, please confirm if a PO will be required before the kickoff or if we can run the initial 2 weeks while redlines are processed.

One question for Ethan/Dev: What access do you need for the dev endpoint? SSH keys, temporary API token, or S3 access to drop the dataset?

Happy to proceed with the proposed kickoff on 6 Jul - Bob and I are available that morning.

Best,
Alice
Senior Product Manager, Search | Acme Corp
Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
